title: Audit and sharpen the permutation block Bessel depth
objective: Independently reconstruct C030, certify or refute the q=3 n=10 two-pole-ring candidate, and seek a growing-depth consecutive-block or volume-basis certificate K_q >= c P_ker with c independent of n.
acceptance_checks: Treats Bessel projection as a Loewner lower bound and does not confuse a certificate failure with a T080 counterexample.
Uses the full K-2P_ker Loewner condition, including kernel-range coupling.
Checks exact feature-Gram probabilities for overlapping, incompatible, and cyclic block constraints.
Any declaration that q=3 is refuted is exact, interval-certified, or independently high-precision reconstructed.
Tests signed rank one, block sums of rank-one clusters, and the two-pole-ring family.
